context.guidance: Give each Data Principal a route to correct, complete or update every user-editable Personal Data Element, and apply the change in every store the value lives in, including caches and derived records. §12(2) provides the right to correction, completion and update, and Rule 14 sets how the Data Principal exercises it.

value.fix: Make the profile update propagate to every place the value is stored, not just the users table. (1) After `user.update(...)` succeeds, refresh the session cache entry for `req.cookies.token` in `security.authenticatedUsers` with the updated record, or delete it and reissue the token. Otherwise `loggedInUser.data` keeps the old values until the session expires. (2) Apply the same change to derived records that copy the value, such as reviews, feedback, baskets or orders that store the username or email, inside one transaction with the user update so they cannot drift. (3) Confirm a correction route exists for every user-editable personal data element, and that it is exposed to the Data Principal under Rule 14: authenticated self-service, validated input, a confirmation response, and a logged request with a response deadline. (4) Add a regression test that updates a field, then checks the cache, the users table and a derived record all return the new value. Also stop echoing `req.socket.remoteAddress` in the error message.
